verdict.rationale: Tensor throughput is a core spec axis for a datacenter GPU, so the story applies. The evidence pack contains no TFLOPS or TOPS figures at any precision, with or without sparsity. It offers only relative marketing multipliers (1.9X Llama2, 1.6X GPT-3, 110X vs CPUs) plus memory capacity and bandwidth, which is exactly the bare marketing number the story rejects.
